title: polypodium triseriale var. gladiatum
intro: Polypodium triseriale var. gladiatum, commonly known as Gladiate Polypody, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Gladiate Polypody are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticoagulant properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
